SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name AS realName, u.role, u.stall_id AS stallId, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.status, u.create_time AS createTime, s.name AS stallName, s.window_no AS stallWindowNo, s.area AS stallArea, s.floor AS stallFloor, s.category AS stallCategory, s.manager_name AS managerName, s.manager_phone AS managerPhone, s.hygiene_score AS hygieneScore, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish d WHERE d.stall_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1) AS dishCount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) FROM dish_review r INNER JOIN dish d2 ON d2.id = r.dish_id AND d2.deleted = 0 WHERE d2.stall_id = s.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1) AS avgRating, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(x.qty), 0) FROM ( SELECT ds.quantity AS qty FROM dish_sales ds WHERE ds.stall_id = s.id UNION ALL SELECT oi.quantity AS qty FROM dining_order_item oi INNER JOIN dining_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.pay_status = 'PAID' WHERE o.stall_id = s.id AND oi.deleted = 0 ) x) AS salesCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON s.id = u.stall_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'MERCHANT'
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.window_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id DESC
